geopolitics_summary: Trump diesel export ban threat drives EU reserve releases; Middle East conflict sustains crude/product prices; trade tensions shape EU policy posture.

themes.headline: Trump threatens US diesel export ban; EU considers strategic reserve release
themes.why_it_matters: US diesel export restrictions would tighten European refinery feedstock availability and raise fuel costs, increasing power-generation fuel switching pressure and lifting spark spreads on thermal units.

themes.headline: G7 agrees oil reserve release after US push; diesel export ban averted
themes.why_it_matters: Coordinated reserve release and avoided US export ban reduce near-term crude/diesel tightness; lowers refinery margins and fuel-cost inflation, easing power plant operating costs over weeks-to-months horizon.

themes.headline: Crude oil, refinery margins rise amid persistent Middle East conflict
themes.why_it_matters: Higher crude and product prices increase power-plant fuel costs and fuel-switching incentives (oil-to-gas arb); elevated refinery margins constrain fuel availability and lift thermal power cost curves.

themes.headline: US natural gas production hits record high in July 2026
themes.why_it_matters: Record US natgas production, especially from Permian, supports LNG export potential and strengthens supply chains to Europe via Atlantic arbitrage; downward pressure on TTF if export capacity utilised.

themes.headline: Italy seeks EU fiscal rule relaxation to fund higher energy costs
themes.why_it_matters: EU fiscal constraints on energy spending may limit demand-side policy response (price caps, subsidies); affects member-state power purchasing behaviour and DA/Cal+1 curve resilience.

watchlist: US diesel export restrictions — escalation risk; monitor Trump admin rhetoric and formal proclamations.
G7 reserve release timing and volume — watch for drawdown impact on global crude/product inventories.
Middle East geopolitical developments — upstream production disruptions would feed crude curve.
EU fiscal rules debate outcome — determines scope of member-state energy support capacity.
